chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj said: Indeed, 'Abbad al-Basri asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) while I was present,

how does a man perform al-li'an (mutual cursing) with his wife? So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, a man from the Muslims came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: O Messenger of Allah, what do you think if a man enters his house and finds a man having intercourse with his wife, what should he do?'
He said: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) turned away from him, so the man left, and that man was the one who was tested with that by his wife.'

He said: 'Then revelation came from Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, with the ruling for her, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) sent for that man and called him and said: You are the one who saw a man with your wife?' He said: Yes.'
He said to him: 'Go and bring me your wife, for indeed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has revealed the ruling for you and for her.' So her husband brought her.
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) made her stand, then said to the husband: 'Bear witness four times by Allah that you are among the truthful in what you accused her of.'
He said: 'Then He said to him: Fear Allah, for the curse of Allah is severe.'
Then He said to him: 'Bear witness the fifth that the curse of Allah is upon you if you are among the liars.'
He said: 'So he bore witness, and He ordered that he be moved away.'
Then He said to the wife: 'Bear witness four times by Allah that your husband is among the liars in what he accused you of.'
Then He said to her: 'Hold fast,' and he admonished her.
Then He said to her: 'Fear Allah, for the wrath of Allah is severe.'
Then He said to her: 'Bear witness the fifth that the wrath of Allah is upon you if your husband is among the truthful in what he accused you of.'
He said: 'So He separated them and said to both of them: Do not reunite in marriage ever after you have performed al-li'an.'
ai.seo_question: What is the step-by-step procedure for al-li'an (mutual cursing) in Shia jurisprudence as narrated from the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* elucidates the procedural details of *al-li'an* (mutual cursing) as revealed to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), emphasizing the transition from divine revelation to judicial application. It highlights the specific oaths taken by both parties—four affirmations of truthfulness and a fifth invoking divine curse or wrath—culminating in a permanent separation (*talaq*) without a subsequent divorce count, a ruling distinct from standard divorce in Shia jurisprudence.
